_comment: Version resource compiled into agenthub-gui.exe by `wails3 generate syso`.
Templated at package time by build/windows/Taskfile.yml, the same way
build/darwin/Info.plist is: {{.ShortVersion}} is the plain x.y.z and
The split is not cosmetic and is the same one macOS forces. `fixed`
holds FILEVERSION/PRODUCTVERSION, which Windows requires to be four
NUMBERS — anything else is silently truncated or rejected, so the
-<hash> suffix cannot go there. The string table below is free text, so
that is where the full build identity lives, and it is the one a user
reads off the file's Properties dialog when reporting a bug.
This is what fills in the Details tab of Properties. An unsigned
executable with no version resource at all is what SmartScreen and every
corporate allowlist treat with the most suspicion.
